fix(click): a click the daemon has read runs however late its turn comes (#947)

* fix(click): a click the daemon has read runs however late its turn comes, and a click already waiting on its socket is read before the backstop answers

* fix(click): the deferred backstop turn's order is part of the clock's contract, held and real, and the late-click TIMEOUT has its end-to-end case back

* fix(click): the held clock keeps its turn order, the url frame's late click has its end-to-end case, and the guard's reach is stated as the wait for a complete frame

* test(click): the real-loop defer case needs no directory, and two stale 'read in time' wordings say what the daemon read
